died.name: Wolfe Tone
died.cause: when told a wound in his throat would reopen and cause him to bleed to death if he spoke. Tone died in prison under unclear circumstances (possibly suicide) while awaiting execution by hanging
died.last_words: I can yet find words to thank you, sir; it is the most welcome news you could give me. What should I wish to live for?

died.cause: Hill shouted these words after Deputy Shettler, who led his firing squad, called out the sequence of commands preparatory to firing ("Ready, aim")
